components.name: Avatar
components.description:
A person or entity as a circle. An image when there is one, the initials
of the name when there is not, never an empty grey disc.
components.a11y: Verified 2026-07-30: initials are text-secondary on the surface-inset wash, 7.74:1 in light and 7.33:1 worst in dark, AAA both. With an image the img carries alt; without one the root is role=img labelled by name and the initials are aria-hidden, so it announces once, as the person, never as two letters.

components.name: BrandWordmark
components.description:
BrandWordmark (brand refresh, 2026-09-22): the custom E, L, T, A, B
glyphs as stroke paths at the locked settings (weight 12, width 58,
height 130, tracking 16, soft corners), filled with the seeded brand
pattern and a grain, or in plain ink. A labelled image: the pattern
layers are aria-hidden. It never moves, so reduced motion needs nothing.
components.a11y: role=img with the word as its accessible name; the pattern layers are aria-hidden. The ink variant is text-primary (AAA). Static: nothing moves, so reduced motion needs no change.

components.name: Button
components.description:
Keycaps with real hierarchy: two colour treatments, three tiers, one
primary per view. Labels are Geist caps, never Unique. One job per
state: hover and focus-visible roll the label, active presses the
keycap; a button never lifts on hover (lift is for cards).
components.a11y: Verified 2026-09-22: primary label (text-inverse) 16.0:1 on the ink plate, 10.6:1 light / 11.8:1 dark on the hover plate (AAA). Secondary and tertiary labels are ink, 16.7:1 on panel. Secondary outline border-strong 3.00:1 worst (non-text AA). Focus ring 3px ochre-deep (3.20:1 on panel) / ochre (8.70:1 on the dark surface), 3px offset, focus-visible only.

components.name: Card
components.description:
The one-card system: every card surface renders through this. Flat at
rest (surface-card, a faint border, no shadow), theme-aware by
construction; only interactive cards lift on hover and focus. The only
fixed-light path is Peek, on purpose.
components.a11y: Interactive cards render as a single anchor or button: one tab stop, no nested interactives. Name a card via ariaLabel when its visible content isn't the right name; media is aria-hidden when ariaLabel is set. Focus shows a visible ring (asserted in CI, both themes). Only interactive cards lift on hover and focus; prefers-reduced-motion keeps them still (the shadow still marks hover and focus). Card text sits on surface-card: text-muted 4.64:1 light / 6.03:1 dark, the worst pair (AA).

components.name: DataTable
components.description:
Rows of facts in columns. Sortable headers are buttons with aria-sort,
the header sticks, and an optional single selection fills the chosen row
ochre without dimming any other row.
components.a11y: Verified 2026-10-03: a real table with a visible caption; column headers scope=col, the first cell of each row scope=row. Sortable headers hold a button and carry aria-sort (none, ascending, descending); the arrow is decorative. Selection is a toggle button with aria-pressed in the row header; the selected row is ochre fill with ink text, 9.01:1 (AAA), nested components included (a muted StatusPill label on ochre would be 3.51:1), and no other row changes. Header labels text-secondary on panel, 7.09:1 light / 8.44:1 dark (AAA). With maxHeight the scroll wrapper is a focusable region named by the caption. Sort and select buttons hit the 44px touch-target token; focus ring 3px.

components.name: Icon
components.description:
The only way BELLA renders an icon. Iconoir glyphs from the registry
(one set, declared), sized by the icon ramp, always currentColor so the
themed ink recolours them for free. Decorative by default; a meaningful
icon requires the label prop and never stands without text unless its
accessible name is proven in a Behavior story.
components.a11y: Verified 2026-07-22: aria-hidden by default (decorative); with label, role=img plus aria-label. Colour is always currentColor, so contrast rides on the text token of the context. Sizes from the icon tokens (sm 16 / md 20 / lg 24), stroke from icon.stroke.

components.name: Input
components.description:
Labelled, stateful, honest about errors. The form is the channel, so the
fields carry the trust.
components.a11y: Verified 2026-07-22: real label element (for/id), 8.33:1 light / 9.20:1 dark (AAA). Field text text-primary on surface, 16.92:1 light (AAA); placeholder text-muted, 4.67:1 worst (AA, opacity reset for Firefox). Errors (status tokens, 2026-09-22): aria-invalid + role=alert message via aria-describedby; 2px danger-border (3:1+ on every surface), WarningCircle icon, message in danger-text (5.84:1 light on panel, 6.86:1 dark on raised; AA). Focus: the 3px focus ring (3px offset) plus an ink edge; an invalid field keeps its danger edge under the ring. 44px min-height.

components.name: PatternField
components.description:
PatternField (brand refresh, 2026-09-22): the brand pattern as a quiet

The folder card. A dark file window on top, a warm sheet below, and a tab

components.name: ScaledFrame
components.description:
THE scaled frame, ported from the portfolio (2026-09-21): the full canvas
renders at its intrinsic design size and scales down to the container.

components.name: ScoreStrip
components.description:
One system's readiness: an overall score and a strip of station scores,
banded sturdy, drifting or check engine. Measured and self-assessed are
told apart in text, never by fill alone.
components.a11y: Verified 2026-10-03: a region labelled by the system heading (level set by as); stations are a labelled list, each spoken as full name, value of 100 and band word, or self-assessed; the visible figure and short label are aria-hidden duplicates. Cell text is ink on every wash, 16.24:1 light / 12.23:1 dark worst (AAA; muted would fall to 6.68:1). Band edges are status borders at 3:1 or better on panel (success, danger) or the control border (3.00:1); the washes alone are near 1:1 on light panel and never carry meaning. The overall bar is aria-hidden, ink on the border-subtle track (14.60:1 / 12.26:1).

Segments hit the 44px touch-target token (portfolio 38px is a recorded divergence).
